# Step 1: parse song titles from downloaded email attachment and determine which to add
# Credentials/tokens
sp_pw=[a for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']
sp_token=apis.spotify.login(username='masmith@gmail.com', password=sp_pw)['access_token']

playlist_id=654
# Fetch current playlist songs
playlist=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=sp_token)
current_song_ids=[s['id'] for s in playlist.get('songs',[])]
current_song_titles=[s['title'] for s in playlist.get('songs',[])]
print('Current playlist:', playlist.get('title'), 'song_count:', len(current_song_ids))
print('Current song ids:', current_song_ids)

# Read attachment file for road trip songs
fs_pw=[a for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='file_system'][0]['password']
fs_token=apis.file_system.login(username='masmith@gmail.com', password=fs_pw)['access_token']
file_path='/home/mason/downloads/songs_for_road_trip.txt'
content=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)['content']
raw_lines=[ln.strip() for ln in content.splitlines()]
song_titles=[ln for ln in raw_lines if ln]
print('Email provided song titles (count={}):'.format(len(song_titles)))
print(song_titles)

# Criteria table (for add operation)
print('\nCRITERIA TABLE - Add songs to playlist')
criteria=[
    ('Song must be on the email list', '"Stephen has sent me a list of songs over email"', 'song title in email list'),
    ('Song must NOT already be present in playlist', '"Add songs ... that are not already there"', 'song_id not in current playlist song_ids'),
]
for row in criteria:
    print(row[0],'|',row[1],'|',row[2])
print('Criteria count:', len(criteria))

# Search songs for each title and exact-match on title
song_title_to_exact_matches={}
for t in song_titles:
    all_results=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.spotify.search_songs(query=t, access_token=sp_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_results.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index+=1
    # exact title post-filter
    exact=[r for r in all_results if r.get('title','').strip().lower()==t.strip().lower()]
    # if none exact, keep empty (avoid guessing)
    song_title_to_exact_matches[t]=exact
    print(f"\nTitle: {t}")
    print(' Total search hits:', len(all_results))
    print(' Exact-title matches:', len(exact))
    if exact:
        print(' Matches (song_id, artists, album):')
        for r in exact[:10]:

results=[]
for sid in need_download:
    try:
        r=apis.spotify.download_song(song_id=sid, access_token=sp_token)

fail=[(sid,err) for sid,st,err in results if st=='fail']
